title: Seahabilitation Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Located just 2 houses outside Seaside in sought after Old Seagrove, Seahabilitation is a 4 bedroom beach house + 1 bedroom guest house. Seahabilitiation sleeps 13 with private (heated) pool, sprawling balconies, and a tower with water views!
description_expanded: LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION!! 'Seahabilitation' is in the heart of it all just 2 houses outside of Seaside and 1 block from the beach in sought after Old Seagrove. 'Seahabilitation' is a 4-bedroom beach house + 1 bedroom guest house sleeping 13 with private (heated) pool, sprawling balconies, and a covered tower with water views! Parking available for 3 cars. This beach house is not to be missed and perfect for the whole family. With an oversized private pool that flanks the length of the main house, you're sure to enjoy your time at home as much as at the beach. The main house offers 4 bedrooms, all with en-suite bathrooms. The first level has an open concept living and dining space with modern kitchen complete with VIKING gas stove, SUB ZERO refrigerator, and every appliance and cooking utensil for the chef in the family to enjoy! A king guest bedroom with additional twin bed and full bathroom completes the main level. Upstairs you'll find the additional three bedrooms. A king master suite with bath/shower combo and dual sinks is just at the top of the stairs. Doors to two shared balconies are just off the master. An additional king guest bedroom means no fighting over the bigger bed when multiple families come. The final bedroom on the 2nd floor is a dual bunk room that sleeps 4 comfortably in twin beds and has its own bathroom as well. Up one more flight of stairs to the best seats in the house. Seahabilitiation offers an oversized, covered tower with full dining table, additional seating and the best views of Gulf of Mexico, Seaside and surrounding beach towns! Sunsets are not to be missed from up here! The expansive pool deck and outdoor hammock/lounging space includes propane fire pit and weber grill perfect for entertaining. The pool deck gives way to the 1-bedroom guest house. This guest house offers its own small living space with mini kitchen and up a spiral staircase is a queen bedroom with cozy private bath. Please note this cottage requires Sat- Sat rentals, 7 nights during Spring Break and Memorial Day through mid-August. If you book for 6 nights, we will have to adjust the rental to meet this requirement. This house requires at least one person over 25 years of age for every three people under 25 years of age Updated TVs with Smart capabilities throughout. Pool can be heated for an additional fee of $250/week; During the months of October - May. (Pool temperature must be lower than 80 degrees to heat.) 2 Complimentary bikes included with your stay Free WiFi Certificate # 041230 TDT # 33597

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
